comment: v3.0 patches (after settings-v2.9.json): ① three-layer room discovery — room-observer.js (L0 client witness) + GET /room-probe/<code> on the server (L1, read-only lobby.getRoom) + merged /presence resolve; ② settings button joins the 参数 row (title-room__cfg style); ③ 字体 back to a five-step slider (85..125 step 10), 间距 back to a continuous slider (0..40, no snap). All web/server-overlay — hot-updatable.
